messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment started for api-service v1.4.0 -> v1.5.0 at 2026-03-15T02:45:21Z. Includes DB migration: remove column 'user_pref_legacy', add 'session_metadata' JSONB. Canary group: pool-canary-2
keisha (oncall): getting pages — spike in 500s on /v1/generate from canary hosts. Seeing steady errors, routing to oncall. :rotating_light:
ashwin (sre): logs from canary-02: `ERROR: column \"session_metadata\" does not exist at character 312` — looks like code hitting new column while migration hasn't completed on that node. Can confirm 15% 5xx across canary.
omar (db): I see the migration job on db-shard-2 hung on `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` — vacuum conflicts and long-running transactions blocked it. Replica lag on replica-2 is 6m.
julia (eng-release): hold rollout. applying kill switch for ff_release_v1_5 -> OFF across canary. Notifying deploy manager.
deploy-bot: Feature flag ff_release_v1_5 set to OFF by julia at 02:49:12Z. Canary traffic redirected to v1.4.0.
keisha (oncall): handoff: I'm coordinating. ashwin, can you attempt to clear the migration lock? omar, we need DB status and whether we can rollback migration changes.
ashwin (sre): attempting to identify blocker: `SELECT pid, query, state, age(clock_timestamp(), query_start) AS runtime FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY%';` shows PID 12437 in 'active' for 22m.
omar (db): PID 12437 belongs to earlier maintenance job; it's blocking the concurrent index build. I'll try to cancel that session.
omar (db): killed PID 12437. Index build resumed but now failing on replica sync; some read replicas still return schema error.
julia (eng-release): rolling back code on canary to v1.4.0 now. rollout-manager: start rollback job for pool-canary-2.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for pool-canary-2 at 02:52:13Z by julia.
keisha (oncall): after rollback: canary error rate dropped to baseline, but production regions still show intermittent 500s for a subset of requests — likely because some app instances saw schema change and others didn't (mixed-version reads).
lia (support): CS note: a handful of customers reported failed generation calls and timeouts. Posted incident banner: "Degraded generation performance for some customers; working on mitigation." Will send targeted emails to affected accounts.
nashwin (sre): attempted rollback of migration: `-- attempting reverse migration script` but `ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN` was not executed previously; we removed column in code path. There's an incompat where code expects new column to exist. Short-term mitigation: set feature flag OFF + restart processes on nodes that picked up new binary.
omar (db): longer-term: we need a backward-compatible migration. Removing columns mid-rollout is unsafe. Proposed safe path: 1) deploy code that tolerates missing column (guard reads/writes), 2) deploy migration that `ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS session_metadata JSONB`, 3) backfill as background job, 4) change code to reference column, then 5) drop legacy column in a separate maintenance window.
julia (eng-release): agreed. For immediate next steps: keep ff OFF, finish rollback to v1.4.0 across all pools, coordinate a controlled migration window with DB team, and prepare a non-blocking add column path.
keisha (oncall): customer impact: p50 gen latency increased from 380ms -> 1.2s for impacted calls, error rate peaked at 18% on canary, 4% on prod. Logged incident ID INC-30876. Escalating to SEV-2 given customer impact.
lia (support): drafting customer email: short explanation, mitigation steps, ETA for follow-up. Will include support line.
nashwin (sre): commands run during mitigation (for audit):
```
SELECT pid, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query LIKE '%CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY%';
SELECT pg_cancel_backend(12437);
systemctl restart api-service-canary-02
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-service --to-revision=v1.4.0 -n services
```
omar (db): caution: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` can be blocked by long tx; next time ensure no long-lived transactions (analytics, backup jobs) run during migration. Also monitor replica_lag_seconds < 30s before proceeding.
julia (eng-release): scheduling a controlled migration rehearsal with DB team and SRE: proposed window 2026-03-17 0200-0300 UTC. Will add preflight checks to release pipeline to query replica lag + active tx age.
keisha (oncall): summary & next steps: 1) ff OFF (global) 2) finish rollback to v1.4.0 across all clusters (in progress) 3) schedule controlled migration with backfill plan and no-concurrent long txs 4) postmortem + release pipeline preflight + customer follow-ups.
lia (support): customer comms sent to affected customers, status page updated. Will post final update after postmortem.
deploy-bot: Incident state changed to "mitigated" at 03:10:45Z. Oncall assigned for follow-up: keisha (4h).
nashwin (sre): I'll own the postmortem draft: include timeline, exact log snippets, commands used to kill blocker, decision to rollback, and improvements (preflight checks, non-blocking migrations).
julia (eng-release): I'll own release-side fixes: migration compatibility guard, pipeline preflight, canary rollout policy to pause if any node returns schema errors.
keisha (oncall): thanks team. handoff complete. I'll monitor metrics for next 2 hours and escalate if regression. :thumbsup:
